intent.proves: At least one product is assigned a VAT group that has a country rate.

bindings.reason: Reads per product; a whole-host enumeration handler is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProductVatGroups p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomVatCountryRelations r WHERE r.VatCountryRelGroupId = p.ProductVatGroupVatGroupID)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
